sources.title: CNBC: AMD stock dives on short-seller report of alleged China exposure
Investing.com: Short seller Hunterbrook shorts AMD citing concerns over China exports
Taipei Times/Reuters: TSMC tightens China AI chip curbs

numbers: AMD close 11/19 489.19 (-7.72%), 11/18 530.14; SOX 9419.72 (-2.41%) close 11/19; AMD Singapore billing FY2025 US$4.28B (>10% sales); China+HK >20% revenue; AMD ~30x fwd P/E vs NVDA ~9x (Hunterbrook, as of 11/18).
lesson: AMD -13.22% 對 SOX -2.47%，超額 -10.74% 記 hit。大盤（beta）只貢獻約 -2.5%，其餘是放空報告（Hunterbrook）揭露的中國／新加坡營收疑慮持續發酵、加上東南亞出口管制新規，個股特有利空（idiosyncratic）主導；11/27 費半反彈 +4.7% 時 AMD 也只 +4.6%，沒能補回。
